note: ordinary success -- in denominator, counts as success
ordinary failure -- in denominator, counts as non-success
still pending when the window closed -- the loophole this revision closes: scored UNRESOLVED_AT_WINDOW_CLOSE (non-success), never left permanently unscored
a normal-operation timeout -- still counted, never dropped from the denominator after the fact
a fault/negative-control case -- never enters this denominator regardless of run_state or outcome
environment fault NOT independently confirmed excluded -- counts as a failure in the headline denominator by default (the fix corrects the formula that previously omitted ENVIRONMENT_FAULT entirely)

environment fault that WAS independently confirmed (by the oracle, from external infra logs) to be outside both systems' control -- reported on the parallel infrastructure-excluded line, never silently dropped from the headline line either (both numbers always published together)
oracle judged this task infeasible before it ran -- never enters the denominator regardless of its actual outcome
